summary: EATLY Phase 4 (social layer: Feed + Reels + Posts + Comments + Follow + Search + Reports) regression. Backend pytest: 30/30 PASS in the new /app/backend/tests/test_social_feed.py (feed foryou/following/reels_only/cursor pagination; post CRUD with owner-only delete 403; like/save toggle with GET-verified persistence; /me/saved reflects state; comment add + nested reply, cascading delete of replies when parent deleted, only-owner-can-delete 403, invalid parent 404, empty text 422; comment like; follow toggle w/ profile isFollowing sync; following feed populated; user profile+posts; social search users/restaurants/hashtags; reports with validated target/reason). Existing Phase 1 regression (backend_test.py) also PASS 16/16, and Phase 2/3 (orders/reviews/notifications) covered by iteration_2 remains green. Frontend E2E on mobile viewport 390x844 via preview URL: demo login (andi@eatly.com) -> home 'Halo, Andi' -> /feed shows scope toggle 'Untuk Kamu / Mengikuti', 6 PostCards with post-like-/save-/comment-/options-/follow- testIDs. Toggled a like (persists). Opened CommentsSheet, typed 'TEST_e2e_comment_pw', pressed comment-send: comment appears in the sheet and delete-comment- button rendered for own comment. Create flow: tapped feed-create -> /create -> selected first curated image -> filled caption 'TEST_e2e_publish_flow #enak' -> create-publish -> router.back() to /feed -> new post appears at top with correct caption + hashtag highlight + author=andipras. /reels loads full-screen viewer with 27 reel-related testIDs across ~8 reels; /search and /saved routes render. Restaurant + dish chips render on posts as expected. Non-blocking: (1) 'play() failed because the user didn't interact with the document first' pageerror in reels — Chrome autoplay policy on web preview only, not a real bug (works in Expo Go / native). (2) shadow* deprecation warning persists from prior iterations. (3) Direct URL navigation to /create (bypassing the Feed create button) yields 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' toast after publish because there is no back stack; irrelevant in real usage since publish flow always enters /create via feed-create push.

issues: Deprecation: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (persists from iteration 2)

Chrome autoplay policy: expo-video player emits 'play() failed because the user didn’t interact with the document first' when Reels mounts before any gesture. Native builds unaffected. Consider setting playbackRate/paused=true until first tap on web, or a large 'Tap to play' overlay for the first reel.

action_items: (Optional polish) When /create is opened via a deep link and there is no back stack, replace router.back() after publish with router.replace('/(tabs)/feed') to avoid the 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' toast (edge case only; happy path via feed-create already works).
(Optional polish) On web, gate reel autoplay behind first user interaction to silence the Chrome autoplay pageerror.
(Low priority carry-over) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow, and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.

(Low priority carry-over) server.py is now ~1755 lines — consider splitting into routers/{auth,restaurants,orders,reviews,notifications,social}.py + seed.py to stay under 700 lines per file (currently 2.5x threshold).
critical_code_review_comments: Ownership guard on delete_post and delete_comment correctly returns 403 (verified). Comment delete also cascades replies and adjusts post.comment_count by 1+len(replies) which matches expectation.
toggle_like/toggle_save read the pre-increment doc from Mongo and return the incremented count locally — correct because we already applied $inc but never re-read; verified via follow-up GET.

social_search hashtag counting only counts posts whose hashtag CONTAINS the term (`if tag in h`), which will falsely lump #rendang and #rendangkoja under `q=rendang`. Acceptable for discovery UX but consider exact-match when q starts with '#'.

get_feed cursor uses raw ISO-8601 string comparison on `created_at` — fine because all inserts store `_now().isoformat()`; if a future migration stores tz-naive vs tz-aware mixed, cursor pagination will silently misbehave. Not blocking.
server.py file size is 1755 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; splitting into routers strongly recommended for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for Phase 4 flows tested (login, feed scope toggle, like, comment add + delete surface, create+publish, reels viewer, search, saved routes)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates disposable TEST_-prefixed posts (photo) that are deleted at end of each test class where applicable; a couple of TEST_e2e_publish_flow posts remain in the DB under andi@eatly.com from the frontend publish E2E (safe to leave, main agent can prune).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Social backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_social_feed.py — run `pytest backend/tests/test_social_feed.py -v` (~6s). BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (see conftest). Frontend Playwright login: click [data-testid=login-demo] to autofill, then [data-testid=login-submit]. Note the primary CTA is `Masuk` which also matches the screen title, so prefer testID selectors. Post interaction testIDs are `post-{like|save|comment|options|follow|share}-{postId}` (comment is singular, NOT `post-comments-`). Comments sheet uses `comment-input`, `comment-send`, `delete-comment-{id}`, `reply-{id}`, `like-comment-{id}`. Reels use `reel-{id}` and rail buttons `reel-{like|comment|save|resto|options|mute|follow|resto-chip}-{id}`. Create flow uses `feed-create`, `create-caption`, `create-img-{...suffix}`, `create-tag-resto`, `create-tag-dish`, `create-publish`. Publishing from /create works only when there is a back stack (i.e., entered via feed-create). No blocking issues.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found this iteration. The two console-only observations (shadow* deprecation, Chrome autoplay error on reels) are non-blocking and documented under design_issues + action_items.
